name: Losartan
summary: An angiotensin II receptor blocker used for blood pressure control and kidney protection, with far less cough than ACE inhibitors.
good: Hypertension with albuminuria or when ACE-inhibitor cough is a problem.
clinicalPearls: When cough is the problem with an ACE inhibitor, an ARB is the usual mechanistic escape hatch.
mechanism: Blocks the AT1 receptor, reducing angiotensin II-driven vasoconstriction and aldosterone signaling.
indications: Hypertension, diabetic kidney disease, proteinuria, and blood-pressure control when ACE inhibitors are not tolerated.
interactionNotes: Potassium supplements, potassium-sparing diuretics, and other RAAS blockers can raise potassium further.

warnings: Pregnancy, hyperkalemia, and renal artery stenosis are the classic red flags.
